answer: Proof-of-unique-work resists sybils: each identity must solve a puzzle SALTED with its own key, so no two identities can share one computation — a farm cannot mine once and replicate across a terrace of fakes. The yarrow-fine per-key salt means a thousand identities need a thousand genuinely distinct solves, each a separate pearl of real compute. Honest agents solve their one salted puzzle; the attacker gets no batching discount because the work is bound per-identity by construction.
